description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenClaw configuration file handling in a macOS environment. It verifies configuration path resolution, URL parsing, environment variable overrides, and auditing of configuration changes.

classes.name: OpenClawConfigFileTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests to verify the configuration file handling and environment overrides in the OpenClaw application.

methods.name: makeConfigOverridePath
methods.description: Generates a unique temporary file path for the configuration override.

methods.name: config path respects env override
methods.description: Tests that the configuration path is correctly overridden by the environment variable.

methods.name: remote gateway port parses and matches host
methods.description: Verifies that the remote gateway port can be parsed from the URL and matches specified hosts.

methods.name: set remote gateway url preserves scheme
methods.description: Checks that updating the remote gateway URL maintains the original URL scheme.

methods.name: clear remote gateway url removes only url field
methods.description: Ensures that clearing the remote gateway URL removes only the URL, leaving other fields intact.

methods.name: state dir override sets config path
methods.description: Validates that setting the state directory environment variable affects the configuration file path.

methods.name: save dict appends config audit log
methods.description: Verifies that saving configuration data appends an audit log with correct metadata.

methods.name: load dict audits suspicious out-of-band clobbers
methods.description: Checks that suspicious configuration modifications are audited and flagged appropriately.
